What to Expect

On the day, I stay close but out of the way — no stopping you mid-laugh to pose, no forced looks at the camera. I follow the ceremony, the reactions, the small moments between the big ones: a hand squeezed under the table, your mother's face during the vows. Coverage typically runs 4–12 hours depending on your package, and I shoot in available light whenever possible to keep things feeling real rather than performed.

Why Book with Cristóbal?

I've been documenting weddings for 15+ years, originally in Chile and now from Hội An, Vietnam, with regular coverage in Da Nang as well — which means I've shot in nearly every kind of light, weather, and family dynamic there is. My approach is shaped by documentary photographers like Steve McCurry and Fan Ho: patience over direction, and trust that real moments are always more interesting than staged ones. You won't get a shot list of forced poses — you'll get the day as it actually happened.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you travel to Da Nang for weddings?

Yes — Da Nang is about 30–45 minutes from Hoi An, and I regularly shoot weddings and elopements there with no additional travel complexity.

How many photos will we receive, and how long does delivery take?

You'll get a sneak peek within 24 hours, and the fully edited gallery delivered within 30 days depending on your package.

How do I book?

Fill in the contact form at crismaturana.com/contact. I'll reply within 24–48 hours to schedule a short call. A 30–50% deposit secures your date.
